keywords: history;nemsu history;history of nemsu;history of nemsu main campus;history of the university;history of the campus;nemsu background;nemsu origin;where did nemsu name come from;where did nemsu name came from;where did the name nemsu come from;origin of nemsu name;nemsu name origin;what does nemsu stand for;how does nemsu begin;how did nemsu begin;how did nemsu start;nemsu founded;when was nemsu founded;when was nemsu established;nemsu established;nemsu timeline
answer:
NEMSU stands for North Eastern Mindanao State University. Its institutional roots in Tandag began in 1982, when Bukidnon State College opened the Bukidnon External Studies Center. The university took its present name in 2021 under Republic Act 11584.

NEMSU's history:
- 1982: Bukidnon State College (now Bukidnon State University) opened an extension in Tandag City, the Bukidnon External Studies Center, with 153 pioneering students.
- 1992: Republic Act 7377 created Surigao del Sur Polytechnic College (SSPC), joining the Tandag center with schools in Cagwait, Tagbina, Lianga and San Miguel.
- 1998: Republic Act 8628 made it Surigao del Sur Polytechnic State College and added the Cantilan campus.
- 2010: Republic Act 9998 converted it into Surigao del Sur State University (SDSSU).
- 2018: An agreement with the University of Southeastern Philippines led to the gradual turnover of the Bislig campus.
- 2021: Republic Act 11584 renamed SDSSU to North Eastern Mindanao State University (NEMSU).

Full story: https://nemsu.edu.ph/about/university
